courses.title: Introduction to Web Development
courses.description: Learn the fundamentals of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build your first website.
courses.fullDescription: This comprehensive course covers the essential building blocks of web development. You'll start with HTML structure, move on to CSS styling, and finish with JavaScript interactivity. Perfect for beginners who want to create their first website from scratch.

lessons.title: HTML Basics
lessons.description: Understanding HTML structure and semantic elements

lessons.title: CSS Styling
lessons.description: Learn to style your HTML with CSS properties and selectors

lessons.title: JavaScript Fundamentals
lessons.description: Introduction to variables, functions, and DOM manipulation

lessons.title: Responsive Design
lessons.description: Make your website work on all devices with responsive techniques

courses.title: Python Programming Fundamentals
courses.description: Master Python programming from basics to intermediate concepts.
courses.fullDescription: Dive deep into Python programming with this hands-on course. You'll learn data types, control structures, functions, and object-oriented programming. By the end, you'll be able to build your own Python applications and scripts.

lessons.title: Python Setup and Basics
lessons.description: Install Python and write your first program

lessons.title: Data Types and Variables
lessons.description: Understanding strings, numbers, lists, and dictionaries

lessons.title: Control Flow
lessons.description: Learn if statements, loops, and conditional logic

lessons.title: Functions and Modules
lessons.description: Create reusable code with functions and import modules

courses.title: Data Science with Python
courses.description: Learn data analysis, visualization, and machine learning basics.
courses.fullDescription: Transform raw data into meaningful insights with this comprehensive data science course. You'll work with real datasets, create visualizations, and build your first machine learning models using Python libraries like pandas, matplotlib, and scikit-learn.

lessons.title: Introduction to Data Science
lessons.description: Understanding the data science workflow and tools

lessons.title: Data Visualization
lessons.description: Create charts and graphs with matplotlib and seaborn

lessons.title: Machine Learning Basics
lessons.description: Introduction to supervised and unsupervised learning

lessons.title: Project: Analyzing Real Data
lessons.description: Complete a data science project from start to finish
